turn.content: The evidence is conclusive. PO-2026-0209 ordered exactly one set of these four lines (2 soap, 1 freshener, 2 tissue, 1 cleaning service), and the only goods receipt GR-2026-0209 delivered exactly that quantity once. Earlier invoice BHS2600663 (2026-09-13, same PO) already billed 9,231,870 — the identical total to BHS2600671 — so together the two invoices bill this one delivery twice.
